description:
Diluc Ragnvindr is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

Born into the affluent Ragnvindr Clan , Diluc is the current owner of the Dawn Winery and a nobleman of high esteem in Mondstadt . While a past incident caused him to split ways with the Knights of Favonius , he continues to protect Mondstadt in his own way.
role_summary: Diluc Ragnvindr is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Tempered Sword
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes. Charged Attack Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes. At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Searing Onslaught
talents.description: Performs a forward slash that deals Pyro DMG . This skill can be consecutively used 3 times. Enters CD if not cast again within a short period.

talents.name: Dawn
talents.description: Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG . The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of AoE Pyro DMG . The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with Pyro .

talents.name: Relentless
talents.description: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.

talents.name: Blessing of Phoenix
talents.description: The Pyro Infusion provided by Dawn lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% Pyro DMG Bonus during the duration of this effect.

talents.name: Tradition of the Dawn Knight
talents.description: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Claymore -type weapons.

c1.name: Conviction
c1.effect: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.

c2.name: Searing Ember
c2.effect: Description Gameplay Notes When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s. This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s. When Diluc takes damage while having a shield, the effects of this constellation will still activate. This constellation can be triggered by damageless hits from teammates, such as Dori 's Electro application , Kujou Sara 's buff application , and Aura Checks from Anemo characters capable of Elemental Absorption . When Diluc's HP is reduced by HP Loss effects, such as Furina 's Elemental Skill or the Corrosion status, the effects of this constellation will not activate.

c3.name: Fire and Steel
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Searing Onslaught by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Flowing Flame
c4.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview Casting Searing Onslaught in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt. 2s after casting Searing Onslaught , casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s. With Flowing Flame, Diluc's hands will be ignited with Pyro after casting Searing Onslaught . Visual effects while Flowing Flame is active

c5.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Dawn by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
c6.effect: Description Preview After casting Searing Onslaught , the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%. Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark Preview.mp4 Using Elemental Skill without interrupting Normal Attack combo
